generate_random_data: generate random or synthetic input batches with dense and sparse features for DLRM model training
read_dataset: read and preprocess Criteo Kaggle or Terabyte dataset into training and testing batches for DLRM
generate_uniform_input_batch: generate a batch of uniformly distributed dense features and sparse embedding indices for DLRM
trace_profile: profile a memory access trace to compute stack distances and unique line accesses for synthetic data generation
trace_generate_lru: generate a synthetic memory access trace using LRU-based stack distance distribution from a profiled trace file
